subject.title: fix(azure): responses model aliases route correctly

question: Should manifest alias ownership and transport metadata use this shared precedence for Azure Responses, OpenAI suppressions, GitHub Copilot, and future provider aliases?
rationale: Green CI and the supplied proof establish the tested behavior, but they cannot choose the permanent cross-provider ownership contract or confirm that its broader compatibility impact is intended.

options.title: Approve shared precedence
options.body: Accept the centralized rule after refreshing the branch against current main and confirming the existing Codex suppression contract.

options.title: Narrow the Azure repair
options.body: Limit the change to Azure Responses ownership if maintainers do not want manifest aliases to define shared transport precedence yet.

options.title: Pause for resolver design
options.body: Hold the PR while an owner defines a smaller canonical provider-owner and transport API for all manifest-backed aliases.

recommendation.title: Approve shared precedence
recommendation.body: Accept the centralized rule after refreshing the branch against current main and confirming the existing Codex suppression contract.
